summary: Paramount Skydance filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a contingent distribution of 471,300,000 transferable warrants to purchase Class B common stock, one warrant per share held on the October 5, 2026 record date, tied to its proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. Each warrant has a $12.00 exercise price, ten-year term to October 13, 2036, and early-expiration trigger after three years if the stock trades above a threshold for 20 of 30 days. Closing is expected on or about October 6, 2026; the board declared the distribution. Watch deal closing and warrant overhang.
